text:
Counting the grapes on the plate: left cluster has about 7 (dark small one, red large, green-yellow, red, red, dark small, and another red), right cluster has about 6. That gives roughly 13 grapes.

Each grape looks medium-to-large, about 5-6 g, so the total is roughly 13 × 5.5 ≈ 70 g.

Grapes have about 0.69 kcal/g, so 70 g ≈ 48 kcal.
